findings.claim: 10-K 列出各業務主要對手（健身：Apple、Coros、Huawei、Oura、Whoop 等；航空：Honeywell、Collins 等；船用：Furuno、Raymarine 等），並指出現有與新興對手能複製部分功能，部分 OEM 客戶可能自製，可能造成降價與市占流失。
findings.excerpt: existing and emerging competitors have been able to replicate certain features offered by some of our products and services or respond more rapidly to emerging technologies or changes in customer requirements. Some of our original equipment manufacturer (OEM) customers may develop in-house equipment and components that they currently purchase from us.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 搜尋摘要未提供可逐字複製原文，Omdia／Counterpoint 份額資料以 clues 提供；航空、船用未查到新進入者來源。

clues.claim: Omdia 2Q26：Garmin 智慧手錶份額 15%（去年同期 11%），與 Samsung 持平（Samsung 17%→15%），Apple 48%→46%。
Counterpoint 2Q26：Garmin 智慧手錶出貨成長 11%，全球份額 5.6%；Huawei 居首 22%。
